entities.summary: Salvatore Rossi OMRI is an Italian economist and civil servant who serves as the director of the Bank of Italy since May 2013. Prior to his position, he served in several financial and economic institutions in Italy, including as chair of the board of directors of Telecom Italia from October 2019 to April 2024.
